about: Cross-ecosystem policy vectors. Byte-identical in Dinify-Frontend, Dinify-Admin and Dinify-Backend; the JavaScript and Python evaluators are both tested against every case. Change it in all three or in none.

cases.name: CONTROL: a complete scan with no findings is within policy
a collection failure with no findings is incomplete, never clean
runtime high blocks
runtime low blocks: any advisory on a shipped package
runtime advisory of unknown severity blocks
tooling high blocks: a devDependency is not excused
tooling critical blocks
scanner-graph moderate is visible triage, not zero
tooling moderate requires triage and is counted
tooling low and info require triage
tooling advisory of unknown severity cannot be evaluated
unknown scope below high cannot be evaluated
unknown scope at high still blocks
a finding missing its version is incomplete
a valid narrow exception passes, visibly
